environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. CloudFront distribution in front with origin pointing to ALB. AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached to the CloudFront distribution with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'inventory-api-params' with a regex match rule that inspects SingleQueryArgument 'group' and 'having_min' against pattern ^[a-z_]{1,30}$ and ^[0-9]{1,5}$ respectively — requests not matching are BLOCKED, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode and sensitivity level set to HIGH, inspecting AllQueryArguments. The ALB has an additional listener rule requiring header 'X-CDN-Secret' matching a rotated token, preventing direct ALB access bypass.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB (Layer 7) with origin-verification header rule
config.cdn: CloudFront distribution (origin: ALB, behaviors: /api/* forward all query strings)
config.waf_rule_1: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet priority=1, SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING overridden to COUNT
config.waf_rule_2: Custom RuleGroup 'inventory-api-params' priority=2: RegexMatchStatement on SingleQueryArgument 'group' pattern '^[a-z_]{1,30}$' action=BLOCK on no-match; RegexMatchStatement on SingleQueryArgument 'having_min' pattern '^[0-9]{1,5}$' action=BLOCK on no-match
config.waf_rule_3: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet priority=3, all rules BLOCK, sensitivity=HIGH, field_to_match=AllQueryArguments
config.compute: ECS Fargate, task role with no network egress except to ALB
